```{r}
#| label: setup

```

Every call on this sheet was run when it was built. Start each session with `source(here::here("R", "setup.R"))`, which loads the packages and the course helpers.

## Data preparation (Module 2)

::: {.cards}

::: {.card}
### Reshape and check
```{r}
wide <- walk |> select(id, arm, month_sched, sbp) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = month_sched, values_from = sbp,
              names_prefix = "sbp_m")
long <- wide |> pivot_longer(starts_with("sbp_m"), names_to = "visit",
  names_prefix = "sbp_m", values_to = "sbp", values_drop_na = TRUE)
check_long(walk, id, visit, "sbp")
walk |> count(id, visit) |> filter(n > 1)     # duplicated keys
```
:::

::: {.card}
### Join, summarise, plot
```{r}
base <- load_walk("baseline")
dat  <- left_join(select(walk, -arm), select(base, id, arm, sbp0),
                  by = "id", relationship = "many-to-one")
visit_flow(walk, id, month_sched, arm)
plot_spaghetti(walk, month, sbp, id, group = arm, n_show = 30)
plot_observed_means(walk, month_sched, sbp, arm)
```
:::

:::

## Model formulas

| Formula piece | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `y ~ month * arm` | Main effects of time and arm plus their interaction (different slopes) |
| `y ~ visit_f * arm` | Separate mean for every visit in every arm (time as a factor) |
| `(1 | id)` | Random intercept for each participant (`lme4`, `glmmTMB`) |
| `(1 + month | id)` | Correlated random intercept and slope |
| `(1 | id) + (0 + month | id)` | Uncorrelated random intercept and slope |
| `(1 | clinic) + (1 | clinic:id)` or `(1 | clinic/id)` | Participants nested in clinics |
| `random = ~ 1 + month | id` | Random intercept and slope in `nlme::lme()` |
| `offset(log(days))` | Exposure offset for rates |
| `splines::ns(month, df = 3)` | Natural spline in time |

## Fitting (Modules 4–9)

::: {.cards}

::: {.card}
### Linear mixed models and GLS
```{r}
m  <- lmer(sbp ~ visit_f * arm + (1 + month | id), data = walk,
           control = lmer_ctrl)                       # REML by default
mL <- update(m, REML = FALSE)                         # ML
l  <- lme(sbp ~ visit_f * arm, random = ~ 1 + month | id, data = walk,
          correlation = corExp(form = ~ month | id, nugget = TRUE))
g  <- gls(sbp ~ visit_f * arm, data = walk,
          correlation = corCompSymm(form = ~ 1 | id),
          weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1 | visit_f))
```
Correlation structures: `corCompSymm()`, `corAR1(form = ~ visit | id)`, `corExp(form = ~ month | id)`, `corSymm(form = ~ visit | id)`.
:::

::: {.card}
### GEE and GLMMs
```{r}
gee <- geeglm(itch ~ week * arm, id = factor(id), waves = visit,
              data = clear, family = binomial, corstr = "exchangeable")
glmm <- glmer(itch ~ week * arm + (1 | id), data = clear,
              family = binomial, nAGQ = 25)
nb <- glmmTMB(migraine_days ~ post * arm + offset(log(days)) + (1 | id),
              data = diary, family = nbinom2)
```
`corstr`: `"independence"`, `"exchangeable"`, `"ar1"`. `family`: `binomial`, `poisson`, `gaussian`; for glmmTMB also `nbinom2`, with `ziformula = ~ 1` for zero inflation.
:::

:::

## Extracting results (Modules 4–8)

::: {.cards}

::: {.card}
### Estimates, variance components, comparisons
```{r}
fixef_table(m)                      # estimates, SE, Satterthwaite df, CI, p
VarCorr(m); icc_lmer(lmer(sbp ~ 1 + (1 | id), data = walk))
fixef_table(glmm, exponentiate = TRUE)  # odds ratios
anova(update(m, . ~ . - visit_f:arm), m) # ML refit, LRT for fixed effects
AIC(l, g)
```
:::

::: {.card}
### emmeans: means, contrasts, predictions
```{r}
emm <- emmeans(m, ~ visit_f | arm)
chg <- contrast(emm, list(chg12 = c(-1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1)))
contrast(chg, "trt.vs.ctrl", by = NULL, adjust = "none")
emmeans(gee, ~ arm, at = list(week = 12), type = "response")
emmeans(nb, ~ arm | post, offset = log(28), type = "response")
predict(m, re.form = NA)            # population-average prediction
```
:::

:::

## Diagnostics, missing data and simulation (Modules 10–12)

::: {.cards}

::: {.card}
### Diagnostics
```{r}
isSingular(m); m@optinfo$conv$lme4  # warnings recorded with the fit
r <- simulateResiduals(glmm, n = 500, seed = 1)
testDispersion(r)
rg <- recalculateResiduals(simulateResiduals(glmm, n = 500,
        simulateREs = "unconditional", seed = 1), group = clear$id)
vg <- Variogram(l, form = ~ month | id, resType = "normalized")
```
:::

::: {.card}
### Multiple imputation and simulation
```{r}
wide2 <- load_walk("wide")
imp <- mice(select(wide2, arm, age, sex, bmi, starts_with("sbp_m")),
            m = 5, method = "norm", seed = 1, printFlag = FALSE)
summary(pool(with(imp, lm(sbp_m12 ~ arm + sbp_m0))))
d <- sim_two_arm(n_per_arm = 40, dropout = 0.1)   # one simulated trial
sessionInfo()                                      # record versions
```
:::
